reviews.title: UX needs attention
reviews.text: There is now a “Text Us” button that sits right over the edit button for the services I’m trying to book. Completely worthless app now. I need to call the store directly to book. Please fix!!!

reviews.title: Never Loads
reviews.text: The search screen never loads any nearby shops. You have to know where you want to go already, which isn’t very helpful when trying to find new places. It also never saves my information so I always have to re-enter my credit card and contact info every time which is annoying.

reviews.title: Didn’t Work
reviews.text: Couldn’t find my appointment, much less manage it. Recommended to use by my salon. Found it useless because the only thing I found was appointments from over 3 years ago. I decided to delete it.

reviews.title: Pathetic experience
reviews.text:
Holy mother of god you guys why do I have to enter my name email phone number and credit card info for booking an appointment WHEN IM ALREADY LOGGED IN???? also, WHY IS THERE NO AUTOFILL OPTIPN FOR MY CC INFO???? Did you guys ever test your own app??? I have to go to 1Password, copy my CC info, come back to the app and oops, the entire app reloaded in the background because your talentless engineers built a memory hogging piece of garbage. It's like you guys desperately don't what your customers to use the app. 

I know you all had big layoffs last year- you should have cut even more of your talentless overpaid coasting hacks.

reviews.title: Adding an appointment to my calendar (full calendar access?!?!)
reviews.text:
Why would me as a customer of a vendor using square give square full access to my calendar?

Am I supposed to trust square?

For all I know this was added by an AI coding agent so some hacker can harvest my appointments and things like birthdays, doctors appointments.  

Ahhh no

reviews.title: Useless
reviews.text: Could never login. Never got a txt message and no other method to authenticate.

reviews.title: Full Access to My Calendar?
reviews.text: It absolutely invasion of privacy for Square Go to require FULL ACCESS to my private icalendar, in order for me to add my booked appointments to my calendar. I use other apps and I’m able to add my appointments without giving full access. This is very frustrating!

reviews.title: Excessive calendar permissions
reviews.text: App requires full calendar access to create a calendar event from an appointment. Sleazy privacy invading design.

reviews.title: Security/privacy issue
reviews.text: Be warned, this app needlessly requires FULL calendar access even to add a simple appointment to your calendar. Even though iOS has the permissions granularity for apps to just add an event to your calendar, which would be incredibly helpful, this app deliberately withholds that functionality unless you allow it to read everything you’ve ever scheduled. There’s absolutely nothing stopping them from looking at every meeting you’ve ever been at, the people you met with, and where you met them. There is nothing stopping them from uploading all of that to the cloud, and selling it to advertisers. This is a privacy and security nightmare.
